What is Get High And Fly?

GHAF is an annual big air kitesurfing competition. Riders from across the region gather to push limits, fly higher, and compete in the most spectacular discipline in kitesurfing.

Whether you're a seasoned pro or an ambitious amateur — there's a place for you here. The competition runs across four categories, with qualified judging and full safety setup.

Volunteer

GHAF runs on the energy of its volunteers. We need people who love the sport and want to be part of something special.

Judges

Assist certified judges on the water. Experience in kitesurfing required.

Photo & Video

Capture the competition. Bring your own gear. Credit in all publications.

Media & Social

Run live updates, interact with the audience. Fluent in at least one competition language.

What you get: accreditation, meals, accommodation assistance, GHAF merch.
